title: Volume of a Sphere: Formula, Derivation, Worked Examples and Common Mistakes
seoTitle: Volume of a Sphere: Formula (4/3)πr³ With Examples
seoDescription: Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³. See the hemisphere and hollow sphere formulas, a no-calculus derivation, 6 solved examples and the mistakes that cost marks.
